doneWhen.text: D10: axum feature tls serves TLS 1.3 (1.2 allowed) on TCP with ALPN h2 and http/1.1 from the id_effect_platform::tls Identity; new connections use a reloaded certificate without a restart; hyper-util auto builder gains http2.

The 0.11 ConnectionLimits (crates/id_effect_axum/src/server/connection.rs:65) apply to TLS connections and HTTP/2: header read timeout, connection cap, requests per connection, plus a finite HTTP/2 max concurrent streams and a TLS handshake timeout; each loosening is a recorded dangerous_* opt-out.

HostConfig gains a tls section (cert/key paths or an Identity provider); plain HTTP stays the default without it; prod posture warns when HTTP/3 is enabled without TLS (no Alt-Svc is sent over plain HTTP).
Gate: `cargo nextest run -p id_effect_axum --features tls`; `cargo nextest run -p id_effect_axum --all-features`; `bash scripts/check-dangerous.sh`
